name: 37916 · Knoxville, TN
findings: ZIP 37916 (Knoxville) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37916 (Knoxville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37916 (Knoxville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
